QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Determined Dylan
QuestInfo.2: #bDylan#k is still determined to carry out his elaborate scheme. He's busy planning the next phase and told you to come back later.

0.msg: #b(You reluctantly explain that Delilah isn't enjoying the day so far.)#k

1.msg: It sounds like she just doesn't know how to appreciate a good adventure. And why would she want to ride the carousel? That isn't thrilling or exciting at all! But if Delilah prefers the carousel, maybe I should change the plan.

2.msg: No! I should stick with the plan! \nMy instinct never worked in the past. This cardio thing has to work! Thanks for checking, #e#h0##n, but this is the way it has to be. She'll understand later once she hears how much I love her.
